summary: Pearson plc furnished a routine Form 6-K reporting total voting rights and capital as of close of business 31 October 2026. The company had 601,815,439 ordinary shares of 25p each admitted to trading, each carrying one vote, with no shares held in Treasury. The figure is offered as the denominator for FCA Disclosure and Transparency Rule notifications and is made under DTR 5.6.1. No transaction, strategic event, or board recommendation is involved; the filing is an administrative share-capital disclosure, not a special situation.
